ogrinfo_format_parquet:
Format Details:
  Short Name: Parquet
  Long Name: (Geo)Parquet
  Supports: Vector
  Extension: parquet
  Help Topic: drivers/vector/parquet.html
  Supports: Open() - Open existing dataset.
  Supports: Create() - Create writable dataset.
  Supports: Virtual IO - eg. /vsimem/
  Creation Field Datatypes: Integer Integer64 Real String Date Time DateTime Binary IntegerList Integer64List RealList StringList
  Creation Field Data Sub-types: Boolean Int16 Float32 JSON UUID
  Supported SQL dialects: OGRSQL SQLITE

<LayerCreationOptionList>
  <Option name="COMPRESSION" type="string-select" description="Compression method" default="SNAPPY">
    <Value alias="UNCOMPRESSED">NONE</Value>
    <Value>SNAPPY</Value>
    <Value>GZIP</Value>
    <Value>BROTLI</Value>
    <Value>ZSTD</Value>
    <Value>LZ4_RAW</Value>
    <Value>LZ4_HADOOP</Value>
  </Option>
  <Option name="GEOMETRY_ENCODING" type="string-select" description="Encoding of geometry columns" default="WKB">
    <Value>WKB</Value>
    <Value>WKT</Value>
    <Value alias="GEOARROW_STRUCT">GEOARROW</Value>
    <Value>GEOARROW_INTERLEAVED</Value>
  </Option>
  <Option name="ROW_GROUP_SIZE" type="integer" description="Maximum number of rows per group" default="65536" />
  <Option name="GEOMETRY_NAME" type="string" description="Name of geometry column" default="geometry" />
  <Option name="COORDINATE_PRECISION" type="float" description="Number of decimals for coordinates (only for GEOMETRY_ENCODING=WKT)" />
  <Option name="FID" type="string" description="Name of the FID column to create" />
  <Option name="POLYGON_ORIENTATION" type="string-select" description="Which ring orientation to use for polygons" default="COUNTERCLOCKWISE">
    <Value>COUNTERCLOCKWISE</Value>
    <Value>UNMODIFIED</Value>
  </Option>
  <Option name="EDGES" type="string-select" description="Name of the coordinate system for the edges" default="PLANAR">
    <Value>PLANAR</Value>
    <Value>SPHERICAL</Value>
  </Option>
  <Option name="CREATOR" type="string" description="Name of creating application" />
  <Option name="WRITE_COVERING_BBOX" type="boolean" default="YES" description="Whether to write xmin/ymin/xmax/ymax columns with the bounding box of geometries" />
  <Option name="SORT_BY_BBOX" type="boolean" default="NO" description="Whether features should be sorted based on the bounding box of their geometries" />
</LayerCreationOptionList>

<OpenOptionList>
  <Option name="GEOM_POSSIBLE_NAMES" type="string" description="Comma separated list of possible names for geometry column(s)." default="geometry,wkb_geometry,wkt_geometry" />
  <Option name="CRS" type="string" description="Set/override CRS, typically defined as AUTH:CODE (e.g EPSG:4326), of geometry column(s)" />
</OpenOptionList>

  Other metadata items:
    ARROW_VERSION=19.0.1
    ARROW_DATASET=YES
